verses.pali: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, appamattakampi muttaṁ duggandhaṁ hoti … appamattakopi kheḷo duggandho hoti … appamattakopi pubbo duggandho hoti … appamattakampi lohitaṁ duggandhaṁ hoti;
verses.english: “Just as even a little bit of urine, or spit, or pus, or blood still stinks,

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho ahaṁ, bhikkhave, appamattakampi bhavaṁ na vaṇṇemi, antamaso accharāsaṅghātamattampi”.
verses.english: so too I don’t approve of even a little bit of continued existence, not even as long as a finger-snap.”
